recipe.preparation_only_dependency: fonttools==4.60.1; not required for static builds or PDF rendering
recipe.python_source:
from fontTools.ttLib import TTFont
from fontTools.varLib.instancer import instantiateVariableFont
from fontTools import subset
from pathlib import Path
import sys
source, output = map(Path, sys.argv[1:])
font = TTFont(source, recalcTimestamp=False)
instantiateVariableFont(font, {'wght': 400}, inplace=True)
options = subset.Options()
options.recalc_timestamp = False
subsetter = subset.Subsetter(options=options)
subsetter.populate(unicodes=[0x20, 0x5F55, 0x767B])
subsetter.subset(font)
for record in font['name'].names:
    if record.nameID in {1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 16, 17}:
        value = {1: 'ScienceToStartup CJK Subset', 2: 'Regular',
                 3: 'ScienceToStartupCJKSubset-Regular-1',
                 4: 'ScienceToStartup CJK Subset Regular',
                 6: 'ScienceToStartupCJKSubset-Regular',
                 16: 'ScienceToStartup CJK Subset', 17: 'Regular'}[record.nameID]
        record.string = value.encode(record.getEncoding())
font.recalcTimestamp = False
font.save(output, reorderTables=True)
